dogecoin.text: @WLitecoin Most of your graphs just dont prove what you say. Dogecoin has been beating Litecoin in transactions. LTC has only been higher in the last couple of weeks (and it has been close).

@BoyMeetsStonk @WLitecoin It’s more likely they sold their supply to buy dogecoin which is more profitable. 2021 is when musks tweets were extremely powerful in increasing dogecoin price. On the basis doge is more profitable as an investment, LTC price will always be a worse investment.
